We identify the leading term and compute its limit. In this case, we raise the main term of the base polynomial to the given power.

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{t\to -\infty }{(4{t}^{3}-t)}^{4} & ={lim}_{t\to -\infty }{(4{t}^{3})}^{4} \\  & ={lim}_{t\to -\infty }256{t}^{12} \\  & =256\cdot {lim}_{t\to -\infty }{t}^{12} \\  & =256\cdot \infty  \\  & =\infty \end{aligned}
$$
